title: 43rd sitting of the 20th Majlis

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/43/2024).
Approval of the minutes of three previous sittings (minutes Nos. 36/2024 to 38/2024).

Question time: Maradhoo MP Ahmed Didi asks the Minister of Fisheries and Ocean Resources, Ahmed Shiyam, on what date work will begin to expand the capacity of the Addu City Fisheries Complex, a government pledge that fishermen badly need.
First reading of the Bill amending the Political Parties Act (Law No. 4/2013), submitted on behalf of the government by Dhidhdhoo MP Abdul Latheef Mohamed.
Preliminary debate on the Bill amending the Elections Commission Act (Law No. 8/2008), submitted on behalf of the government by Kelaa MP Abdulla Shareef.
Unfinished business: continuing the debate on the Bill amending the Anti-Corruption Commission Act (Law No. 13/2008), submitted on behalf of the government by Felidhoo MP Adam Zahir.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting approved old minutes, questioned the fisheries minister on the Addu fisheries complex, introduced the Political Parties Act amendment, and debated the Elections Commission and Anti-Corruption Commission bills.
